prompt: Along a narrow Venetian canal at midday, a sleek black gondola glides beneath an arched stone bridge, its gondolier standing stern with a long oar. Lanterns hang from wrought-iron balconies draped with flower boxes, and pastel-colored buildings with terracotta roofs reflect in the water. A wooden pier juts into the canal beside a striped awning shading a riverside café, where rattan chairs and small round tables hold menus on chalkboard stands. A gelato cart under a vendor umbrella sits near a bakery window displaying crusty bread loaves. Pigeons peck along the canal stone edge as a tourist snaps photos with a handheld camera. Street lamps line the walkway beside an old marble street sign. There is no car, no plastic bag, no bicycle, no telephone pole, and no skyscraper.
